description: This file is a Java unit test class for the class DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl. It contains test cases verifying the behavior of answer building methods for different scenarios related to deleting feature properties in a live command context.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImplTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests the DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl in various scenarios, checking responses and error handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by mocking command properties and creating an instance of the answer builder.

methods.name: tryToGetNewInstanceWithNullCommand
methods.description: Tests that creating a new instance of the answer builder with null command throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithDeleteFeaturePropertiesResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a reply with only a delete response and no event.

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeaturePropertiesNotAccessibleErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a reply indicating that feature properties are not accessible (404 error).

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeaturePropertiesNotModifiableErrorResponseOnly
methods.description: Tests building a reply indicating feature properties are not modifiable (403 error).

methods.name: buildAnswerWithFeaturePropertiesDeletedEventOnly
methods.description: Tests building a reply with a deletion event only, no response.
